_comment: Allowlist of scripts/check-routes.mjs. Every entry needs `methods` (the exact HTTP methods it covers; a method added later is not exempt, a listed method the file no longer exports fails) and a written reason. publicRoutes: files that may use handlePublic()/handleUnscoped() (no session). exceptions: route files that skip the wrapper entirely (also the only way to keep a route.* outside api/). earlyReturns: handlers with code that can return or throw before the wrapper (tracked debt). A stale entry fails the check.

publicRoutes.reason: Sign-in has no session yet; write: true still refuses cross-site requests.
Guest API (menu dish recommendations), public by product design; reads published data only.
Guest API: the published menu of a restaurant, public by product design.
Guest API: table recommendations; a POST that only reads, so no CSRF token (no session).
Health check must not open a request scope (the database failure it reports is 503, not 500); see api-auth.ts.

exceptions.reason: Static public CSV (force-static, generateStaticParams): no request scope, no data, nothing to log per request at runtime.
The metrics endpoint itself: must work with the database down and a scrape must not count in http_requests_total (see the comment in the route); guarded by its own bearer token.

earlyReturns.reason: tracked: fixed by refuseEarly() in the api-robustness branch (K3); remove this entry when that lands (validates ?restaurant= / the id before the wrapper, so a 404/422 there leaves no log line or metric)
